description.zh:
边缘实例ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The ID of the edge instance. On the **Edge Instances** page in the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover your mouse over the name of the target edge instance to view its ID.

You can also obtain the ID by calling the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) API.

description.zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
description.en: The instance ID. Do not pass this parameter for public instances; pass it for Enterprise instances.

description.zh: 授权角色的全局资源描述符（ARN）。在[RAM控制台](https://ram.console.aliyun.com/)创建角色后，单击角色名，可在**基本信息**页查看其ARN。
description.en: The global resource descriptor (ARN) of the authorized role. After creating a role in the [Resource Access Management (RAM) console](https://ram.console.aliyun.com/), click the role name and view its ARN on the **Basic Information** page.

title.zh: 将角色绑定到边缘实例
title.en: Attach a Role to an Edge Instance

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。

> RAM用户共享主账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Conditions
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for this API per Alibaba Cloud account is 10.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot bind-role-to-edge-instance --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --instance-id F3APY0tPLhmgGtx00000 --role-arn acs:ram::17600000000:role/iotedgerole --role-name IoTEdgeRole --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot BindRoleToEdgeInstance --region cn-hangzhou --RoleName IoTEdgeRole --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --InstanceId F3APY0tPLhmgGtx00000 --RoleArn 'acs:ram::17600000000:role/iotedgerole'
